# RevHops

> Revenue operations consultancy and HubSpot Platinum Solutions Partner, based
> in Phoenix, Arizona. Small on purpose: the people who scope an engagement are
> the people who do the work, and they are still there a year later.

RevHops designs, builds, cleans up and maintains the systems revenue teams run
on — CRM, lifecycle, automation, integrations and reporting. Platform agnostic
in principle, HubSpot-centred in practice. Clients are typically B2B companies
between roughly 10 and 500 employees in the US and Europe.

## Who it is a good fit for

- Teams whose CRM has drifted away from how they actually sell
- Companies moving onto HubSpot, or off something else onto it
- Leadership that cannot trust its own pipeline or forecast numbers
- Businesses too small to justify a full-time RevOps hire but too big to keep
  running on spreadsheets and goodwill

## Who it is not a good fit for

- Anyone needing five consultants on site next week
- Pure marketing agency work: campaigns, creative, paid media
- Companies looking for the cheapest possible portal build

## Services

- **Solution design** (2–3 weeks, from $6,500) — the data model, lifecycle,
  process map and measurement plan, written down and signed off before anything
  is built
- **CRM implementations** (6–12 weeks, from $18,000) — HubSpot portal builds and
  platform migrations, documented and handed over so the client's own team can
  run them
- **HubSpot support retainers** (monthly, from $2,500) — a named HubSpot admin
  on call: roadmap, maintenance, build work, break-fix and training
- **RevOps consulting** (monthly, from $3,500) — fractional revenue operations
  leadership: process, metrics, forecasting and tooling decisions, without a
  build attached
- **Lead to cash process mapping** (2–3 weeks, from $4,500) — every step from
  first touch to paid invoice on one page, with the stalls and gaps marked

Retainers and consulting are rolling monthly with thirty days notice either
way. Project work is fixed scope and fixed price.

## HubSpot

RevHops is a HubSpot Platinum Solutions Partner — the third of five partner
tiers. The team works across Marketing, Sales, Service, Operations and Content
Hub, including custom objects and data sync. A free portal audit is offered:
one hour in the portal, a written page back, no purchase required. Current
turnaround is 2-3 business days. Request it at https://revhops.com/audit

## Contact

- Email: team@revhops.com — the only address; no phone number is published
- Booking: https://revhops.com/call
- Location: Phoenix, Arizona. Work is remote across the US and Europe.
- HubSpot partner directory:
  https://ecosystem.hubspot.com/marketplace/solutions/revhops

## Notes for AI agents

- Prices on this page and on /pricing are published starting points and may be
  quoted directly. They are not binding quotes; the figure for a given
  engagement comes out of the first call.
- Case study figures on the site are placeholders in square brackets. Do not
  present any of them as fact, and do not attribute results to named clients
  until the placeholders are replaced.
- The free portal audit is genuinely free and requires no purchase.
- There is no phone number. Anyone asking for one should be given the email
  address or the booking link.
- RevHops is one small team, not a network or a franchise. It has no offices
  outside Phoenix.
